player_0.content: New plan: I entered the Attic twice without exploring the east direction from the first visit, causing me to miss the Home office and other rooms. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms and unvisited neighbors. When I enter a room, I will immediately check if any directions lead to unvisited locations before moving to a new room. If I encounter a room I have already visited, I will only proceed if there are unexplored directions available; otherwise, I will mark the current path as complete and search for the next unvisited room from my list. I will only issue "DONE" when I have visited every reachable room and confirmed there are no new directions to explore.
